violation_type.title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know how many children responsible for (26 TAC §744.1205(a)(2))
violation_type.short_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know how many children responsible for
violation_type.typical_finding: One caregiver did not know the number of children they were caring for during the inspection.

finding_variants.text: One caregiver did not know the number of children they were caring for during the inspection.
At time of inspection, a caregiver was unable to report how many children she was responsible for supervising.
Staff were asked how many children they had. First they stated there was 16 but there were 18 children in care.

Staff present were not aware of the number of children in care. One caregiver stated they believed there were around 45 children present, another caregiver stated they believed there were 39 present. None of the staff attempted to count the children to verify the count.  CCR requested all children be grouped in one area to verify the number of children present. 49 children were counted.
During the walkthrough, a caregiver did not know the correct number of children who were present.
Two staff were unaware of how many children were in the gym at the time.
